story-context.summary:
Create a dedicated behavior notes list page at `/daep/behavior-notes` that allows DAEP administrators to view, filter, sort, and export all behavior notes across students.
Key Features: - 7-column sortable table with pagination (25/page) - Filters: search, category type, campus, staff, date range - Quick filter chips: Today, This Week, Negative, My Notes - Summary stats bar: total, today, negative, unverified counts - "X new" badge for notes since last visit - Student photo thumbnails with initials fallback - Hover tooltip on description for full text - CSV export with 18 comprehensive columns - Verified indicator column (future-ready) - Detail slide-out sheet on row click
